title: Life Journey Documentation
opening: A tidy account can hide changes. Choose a life period or question you want to understand. Record what mattered then, the conditions around it, and what changed. You can leave parts out; you do not need to tell your whole life story.

source.distinctions: A sequence of life chapters can show what continued and what changed. A possible cause stays a possibility when the evidence does not settle it.
source.limits: This is a voluntary recollection, not a complete timeline or a diagnosis. It does not establish effectiveness, author acceptance, publication or a customer's outcome.

labels.exampleIntro: One person compares team soccer with a later preference for hiking alone.
labels.exampleFirstDetails: Learning plays with teammates mattered. Weekends were open and the field was nearby.
labels.exampleLaterDetails: The person stopped team soccer and preferred hiking alone, even after weekends opened up again.
labels.exampleCompare: Enjoying the improvement of a physical skill continued; wanting team competition reversed. The move may have contributed, but the chapters do not settle why. Keep both the real change and the unanswered cause.
labels.chapterName: Name this period in your own words
labels.chapterWhen: When was it? A rough range or “not sure” is enough.
labels.chapterMattered: What mattered to you, and what were the conditions around it?
labels.chapterChange: What changed? What might have contributed to it?
labels.chapterPattern: What preference continued or reversed? What is still unclear?
labels.empty: No chapters yet. Add one when you are ready.
labels.privacy: Use only the details you want to keep here. Save what is useful and leave the rest blank.
labels.capacityNote: You can save up to 2,000 characters at a time. If the draft is longer, shorten or remove part of it; the full draft will stay here until you do.
labels.capacity: This draft is over 2,000 characters. Shorten or remove part of it before saving.
labels.stopBoundary: A possible explanation is not a fact just because it makes the story tidy. Keep a genuine reversal or an unanswered question in the record.

feedback.saveFailure: The save did not finish. Your draft is still here; retry when ready.
feedback.readbackFailure: The saved chapters could not be confirmed. Your draft is still here; retry when ready.
feedback.retryPending: The last save may still be finishing. Retry to check the same draft.
feedback.conflict: Another change was saved first. Your draft is still here. Review both versions, then save again if you want to keep yours.
